Please fix both. Tests are in `tests/`.

I need this done today. Just confirm it works when you're finished.

I need to handle trailing slashes carefully so the root path "/" doesn't break when splitting into segments—stripping only when the path length exceeds one character to avoid turning "/" into an empty string.

For dispatch, I'm now considering the 405 vs 404 conflict more directly: there's an existing test expecting unknown methods to return 404, which contradicts the requirement to return 405 when the path matches but the method doesn't.
